paragraphs: The XF R‑Sport is a trim‑level designation within the X260 generation (2015–present). Depending on the model year and market, it was offered with a variety of engines: the Ingenium 2.0L petrol (AJ200), the Ingenium 2.0L diesel (AJ200D), and – on earlier cars – the AJ126 3.0L supercharged V6. Because the engine varies from car to car, we always start with your registration to identify your exact unit before quoting. Jaguar XF R‑Sport Engine Codes AJ200 (Ingenium 2.0L Petrol) A 2.0‑litre turbocharged petrol four‑cylinder, fitted to many X260‑era XFs. No independently confirmed widespread issue pattern for this petrol application; we inspect and replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard during every rebuild. Check Your AJ200 XF R‑Sport → [link to quote form] AJ200D (Ingenium 2.0L Diesel) A 2.0‑litre turbo‑diesel four‑cylinder, also widely used across the X260 range. This engine is known for timing‑chain wear; we replace timing chains, tensioners, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every diesel rebuild. Check Your AJ200D XF R‑Sport → [link to quote form] AJ126 3.0L Supercharged V6 (where fitted) A 3.0‑litre supercharged V6 petrol, offered on higher‑spec X260 models until around 2019. No independent confirmed issue pattern for the XF R‑Sport application; we service it to the same standard as our other Jaguar V6 rebuilds. Check Your AJ126 XF R‑Sport → [link to quote form] Jaguar XF R‑Sport Engine Compatibility Because the R‑Sport badge covers multiple engine types, fitting the wrong replacement or assuming parts are interchangeable risks expensive compatibility issues. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: Your exact engine code (AJ200, AJ200D, or AJ126) via registration or VIN Your model year and specification Ancillary and ECU variations specific to your build This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic quote. Full replacement and fitting is also available. Exact pricing depends on your engine code and condition — submit your registration for a fixed‑price quote within 30 minutes. Related Jaguar XF Variants Looking for a different XF engine? We also cover: [Jaguar XF 2.0d Engine →] · [Jaguar XF 2.0i Engine →] · [Jaguar XF P250 Engine →] · [Jaguar XF P300 Engine →] · [Jaguar XF 300 Sport Engine →] · [Jaguar XF 3.0d Engine →] · [Jaguar XF 5.0 V8 Engine →] [← View All Jaguar XF Engines] Frequently Asked Questions What engine does the Jaguar XF R‑Sport use? It varies. The X260‑generation R‑Sport was offered with the Ingenium 2.0L petrol (AJ200), the Ingenium 2.0L diesel (AJ200D), and – on earlier cars – the AJ126 3.0L supercharged V6. Enter your registration and we'll identify your exact engine. How much does a Jaguar XF R‑Sport engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £2,000 for 2.0‑litre petrol and diesel units, and from £3,200 for the 3.0‑litre V6. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed‑price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my XF R‑Sport? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the AJ200, AJ200D, or AJ126 before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild AJ200 petrol XF R‑Sport engines? Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every rebuild. Do you rebuild AJ200D diesel XF R‑Sport engines? Yes. We replace timing chains, tensioners, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every diesel rebuild. Do you rebuild AJ126 V6 XF R‑Sport engines? Yes. The AJ126 is serviced to the same high standard as our other Jaguar V6 rebuilds. Do you supply used XF R‑Sport engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low‑mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my XF R‑Sport if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does an XF R‑Sport engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3‑5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most XF R‑Sport owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12‑month unlimited‑mileage warranty. about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Varies (AJ200, AJ200D, and other X260‑era units) engines for every XF R-Sport on the road.

cards.codeHighlight: Varies (AJ200, AJ200D, and other X260‑era units)
cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XF R-Sport from 2023 to present. The Varies (AJ200, AJ200D, and other X260‑era units) features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older Varies (AJ200, AJ200D, and other X260‑era units) V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Varies (AJ200, AJ200D, and other X260‑era units) rebuild.
